tagline: Global expert in electrical power and advanced materials
hero_kpi_rationale: Market leader in renewable energy with 15% growth in 2016 and 19% share of global wind market, demonstrating the group's ability to capitalize on major technological megatrends

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after production costs have been paid.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the quality of premium products and gains in industrial efficiency.
kpis.signal: Solid gross margin for a specialized industrial manufacturer

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before taxes and other financial charges.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving through operational excellence and industrial restructuring.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of sales invested in research and innovation.
kpis.description: Mersen operates 15 R&D centers and invests strategically in advanced materials.

kpis.name: Investments (property, plant and equipment)
kpis.explanation: Expenditures for new factories, machinery or equipment.
kpis.description: Investments support modernization of the industrial network and optimization of the production base.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to support organic growth

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people working in the company.
kpis.description: Overall headcount of 6,110 employees remains stable following industrial organization restructuring, reflecting optimization of the production base.

kpis.name: Sales by region
kpis.explanation: Distribution of sales across major geographic zones.
kpis.description: In 2016, 36% of sales came from North America, 34% from Europe, 25% from Asia, 5% from South America and Africa, reflecting a resilient geographic footprint.
kpis.signal: Balanced presence across North America, Europe and Asia

kpis.name: Renewable energy sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated in renewable energy markets.
kpis.description: Mersen achieved EUR 90 million in renewable energy sales in 2016, notably in solar and wind, representing approximately 19% of the group's consolidated sales.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in solar and wind

kpis.name: Wind power market share
kpis.explanation: Share of global wind market held by Mersen.
kpis.description: Mersen holds 19% of the global wind market, notably through its conversion and electrical protection solutions for power generation and distribution.
kpis.signal: Leader position in the wind market

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2016 annual report.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning or data analytics
Absence of products or services related to AI
Focus on hardware engineering and electrical components
